    Extract Morphometric Parameters

    Source: R/sct-analyze.R
    sct_process_segmentation.Rd

    Runs sct_process_segmentation to compute cross-sectional area (CSA), AP diameter, transverse diameter and other shape metrics of the spinal cord. By default SCT averages the metrics over all slices of the segmentation and leaves the VertLevel column of the CSV empty. Use vert to restrict the average to vertebral levels (VertLevel then lists them), perlevel = TRUE to get one row per level, or perslice = TRUE to get one row per slice with its vertebral level.

    Usage

    sct_process_segmentation(
  sc_seg,
  vert_labels,
  output_dir = NULL,
  perslice = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  vert = NULL,
  perlevel = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    sc_seg

    Character. Path to spinal cord segmentation NIfTI.

    vert_labels

    Character. Path to the vertebral level file, i.e. the labelled segmentation returned by sct_label_vertebrae().

    output_dir

    Character. Directory for CSV output. Defaults to the directory of sc_seg.

    perslice

    Logical. Compute per-slice metrics. Default FALSE.

    verbose

    Logical. Print progress. Default TRUE.

    vert

    Vertebral levels to aggregate over, as a numeric vector (e.g. 2:7 for C2 to C7) or a character string in SCT syntax (e.g. "2:7"). Default NULL (all slices).

    perlevel

    Logical. One row per vertebral level in vert. Needs vert. Default FALSE.

    Value

    Character. Path to output CSV (<sc_seg>_csa.csv), or NA on failure (non-zero exit status, or no CSV written).

    Examples

    # Inputs are checked before SCT is called:
try(sct_process_segmentation("missing_seg.nii.gz",
                             "missing_seg_labeled.nii.gz"))
#> Error in sct_process_segmentation("missing_seg.nii.gz", "missing_seg_labeled.nii.gz") : 
#>   SC segmentation not found: missing_seg.nii.gz

# \donttest{
# With SCT installed: CSA per vertebral level of the PAM50 template cord.
sct <- check_sct(verbose = FALSE)
if (sct$available) {
  pam50 <- file.path(dirname(dirname(sct$path)), "data", "PAM50",
                     "template")
  cord <- file.path(pam50, "PAM50_cord.nii.gz")
  levels <- file.path(pam50, "PAM50_levels.nii.gz")
  if (file.exists(cord) && file.exists(levels)) {
    csv <- sct_process_segmentation(cord, levels, output_dir = tempdir(),
                                    vert = 2:4, perlevel = TRUE)
    if (!is.na(csv)) utils::read.csv(csv, check.names = FALSE)
  }
}
# }
